_comment: Hand-written store release notes for 11.0.0, in both listing languages. tool/gen_changelog.py prefers this file over anything it can derive from the commits, then runs it through the same per-store platform gate as every other source — so keep every line free of operating-system, device and store names. One line per bullet; the leading bullet character is added when the note is written. Keep it short: the Play note is capped at 480 characters including the bullets.
en:
Report comments, issues, files, pages and people, and block people who bother you
Moderation with a clear reason for every decision and a way to appeal
House rules of your organisation, agreed to once
Signing in with single sign-on stays bound to your own account
Many smaller fixes and improvements
de:
Kommentare, Vorgänge, Dateien, Seiten und Personen melden und Personen blockieren
Moderation mit nachvollziehbarer Begründung und Widerspruch
Hausregeln deiner Organisation, einmal bestätigt
Anmeldung per Single Sign-on bleibt an dein eigenes Konto gebunden
Viele kleinere Korrekturen und Verbesserungen
